description: An oil-painting style interior of a stone hall with arches and wall torches. In the foreground a stern, middle-aged man with short greying hair wears a golden-ochre toga with purple stripe over a white tunic, one hand resting on a stone balustrade. Behind him on the right is a white marble bust of a laurel-wreathed man in a toga. Behind the balustrade, rows of togate men in tiers raise their arms and seem to shout or cheer. No visible text, frame or border; the painting fills the image edge to edge.
